verdict.rationale: A recorded runtime probe ran a real end-to-end keyless install with `npx -y skills add mattpocock/skills --skill tdd -a claude-code -y --copy`. It installed the single tdd skill non-interactively, and the installed SKILL.md read back cleanly. The docs also give single-command install paths: `npx skills@latest add`, `claude plugin install`, and the Codex/Copilot plugin commands. missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing the non-interactive/`-y` flags (the documented installer is framed as interactive 'pick the skills and agents'), and independent corroboration beyond the single probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can install a skill by itself — a non-interactive, promptless install path an agent can run headlessly end to end

citations.quote: `npx -y skills add mattpocock/skills --skill tdd -a claude-code -y --copy` fetched the repo, selectively installed the single `tdd` skill to ./.claude/skills/tdd/
the documented skills.sh install path works non-interactively, exactly as the README promises
